notes: Identifier-free search protocol for two correction-trained Track 2 lanes. The targeted-hypothesis lane and the marketed-approved phenotype lane retain separate discovery provenance and separate A0 to A1 paths; neither lane inherits the other's exposure cutoff or result, and each must carry its own clinically plausible exposure rationale. Fill named queries and sample records outside this public tree. Exact correction plus reciprocal recreation defines the rescue signature before medicine results are unblinded. Renewable A0 evidence remains mechanism-only, and only a valid lane-matched A1 result may consume Tier-B context and native-lineage material. A 2-D signal cannot become active without postnatal nontransformed lineage-matched mitotic context, paired 2-D comparison, and same-context correction/recreation. Rank pharmacologic rows through symmetric exposure, jurisdiction-specific regulatory, pediatric, oncology, native-fidelity, completion, clone-safety, context, held-out, and replication gates; role labels cannot hide a displacer. Human pharmacodynamic evidence counts only when it measures the declared target or pathway bridge. Analog, nearby, species-model, complementation, docking, or predictor/ranking records cannot stand in for exact-allele wet function; unmatched, ectopic, cell-free, or imposed-stress assays cannot stand in for an endogenous assay-matched defect. Frequency, conservation, ClinVar, catalog, software, label, database, ontology, or literature records cannot stand in for exact-allele function. Catalog, label, database, or ontology records cannot occupy a pharmacologic ranking role. A derived_evidence row inherits its parent source occupancy. Control, no-go, oncology-stop, unassessed-oncology/exposure, expired, mixed-unsafe, or nontranslational rows cannot occupy conditional hold; exclude and no-go must be rejected. An active_lead row must have role lead. at most one role lead. A synthetic fixture cannot be public. This is not a completed search.
